plan.name: Price plan
plan.hint: Add a row if the same product has courses at different prices.

per.room: by room size (per night, per person)

time.title: When does this product start?
time.hint: You can set several start times per day. The name is shown to customers next to the time. Capacity and selling days are set by rules in the calendar below.
time.name: Name (optional)

itinerary.title: Day-by-day itinerary
itinerary.hint: One row per day. Hidden from customers if left empty.
itinerary.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Fukuoka → Beppu, hot spring visit

stay.title: Itinerary & cutoff
stay.hint: The day-by-day itinerary is shown to customers under the description. Nights are set per plan in the price table (5).

pkg.rulesHint: When a booking comes in, the condition is checked against the date of use, the return date (date + nights) and the Japanese holiday calendar, and the per-person amount per category is added or subtracted automatically. Negative = discount. Customer-chosen discounts belong in customer choices, not here. Untick "Active" to pause a rule.
pkg.when_range: Date of use within a period (e.g. fuel surcharge)
pkg.when_outWeekend: Date of use is Fri–Sun or a holiday
pkg.when_returnWeekend: Return date is Fri–Sun or a holiday (with nights)
pkg.choicesHint: Create groups with the Transport, Stay, Experience and Other buttons. Keep outbound and return as separate groups. Per-person prices are entered per category (adult, child); minimum is the smallest party that option runs for (warning only).
pkg.noGroups: No groups yet. Leave it empty if customers have nothing to choose.
pkg.priceGroupsHint: Manage discounts/surcharges that apply to the whole product (subsidies, fuel surcharges, weekday surcharges) and section-level detailed fees (per-person lodging fees, cabin upgrades, etc.) as tables. A table with one criteria (column) and one option (row) appears as a single amount field. Add columns to hold different amounts by condition, like outbound/return legs.
pkg.noPriceGroups: No tables registered. You can leave this empty if the price is fixed.
pkg.blocksHint: Add a section for each item that needs images and a description, like an itinerary, transport schedule, lodging, or experience program. No limit on the number of sections.
pkg.noBlocks: No sections registered. You can leave this empty if basic info and the price table are enough.
pkg.roomDateRateQuestion: Do any dates have a different rate?
pkg.roomDateRateHint: Leave as is if none. Otherwise, click the date on the calendar.

changeRequest.pendingBanner: A {label} request is pending crosshub approval.
changeRequest.rejectedBanner: The latest {label} request was rejected — reason: {reason}
changeRequest.diffEmpty: No changes to key fields (only details like photos or the schedule changed)
changeRequest.autoRejectReason: Automatically rejected because CrossHub handled the product directly.

products.kindLocked: The type of a registered product can't be changed.
products.name: Product name
products.categoryChangeConfirm:
Your entries are saved only when you click Save draft.
Changing the product category clears everything you have entered so far. Continue?

confirmHint.instant: Confirmed on the spot if available.
confirmHint.quote: The operator checks the request before confirming (for stays/transport).

products.translateNote: The language you enter becomes the original, and it is machine-translated into the other languages when you save.
products.reviewNote: New products are saved as In review and go live on Travel Pass after CrossHub approves them.
products.deleteConfirm: Delete this product? This can't be undone.
products.kindNote: A ticket with a fixed date is type 2; a ticket usable on any day is type 3. Multi-day packages are type 2 with nights on the plan.

kindDesc.time: Customers select both a date and a start time. Kayak, cruise or workshop with capacity per start time
kindDesc.date: Customers pick the date of use. Dated tickets, rentals, same-day facility use
kindDesc.stay: Customers pick a departure date; nights are set per price plan. A 3-day island trip, packages with lodging
kindDesc.pass: No date is selected. A pass or open ticket used on any day within the validity period

products.areaSearchHint: Search the map or drag the pin to set the location. It is shown on the Travel Pass map.
products.areaNoKey: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY to enable map search. Only the area name is saved for now.
products.areaError: Could not load the map. Only the area name is saved.
products.cancelHint: Fees and refunds are calculated from this table when a booking is cancelled.
products.cancelNotePlaceholder: e.g. Airline rules take precedence for flight tickets
products.imagesHint: First photo is the cover. JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC (iPhone), up to {n}. Resized to 1,600px JPEG on upload.
products.cutoffHint: Later cutoffs bring more bookings, but leave time to prepare. Date-only products count from midnight of the date.

avail.title: Calendar
avail.hint: Rules define selling days and capacity. Days without a rule are not sold. Click a cell to change just that day; saved together with the product.
avail.noRules: No rules yet. Press "Add rule" or + in the calendar.
avail.weekdaysHintRange: Leave empty for every day in the period
avail.label: Rule name (optional)
avail.needMax: Maximum capacity must be at least 1
avail.weekdaysHint: Pick the weekdays this rule applies to
avail.paxHint: Bookable only when the minimum is met
avail.timesHint: Pick the start times this rule applies to

priceTable.hint: Columns are the categories customers pick quantities for (adult, child, one bike…); rows are price plans. An empty cell means that category is not sold in that plan.
priceTable.stayHint: Columns are the categories customers pick quantities for; rows are plans with different nights (2 nights / 3 nights). The return date is the departure date plus nights.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.hint: Discount / surcharge rules and customer choices (transport, stay, experiences, add-ons). Leave empty for simple products.

changeFeeHint.same: A date change is treated as cancel + rebook with the same table (Japanese standard terms). Reducing the party charges the cancellation fee on the reduced part; adding only charges the difference.
changeFeeHint.free: No fee for date or party changes when space allows. Adding people only charges the difference.

products.tourDescriptionGuide:
Please include the following.
- Minimum/maximum participants per session
- Meeting point, usage info, and what to bring
- How bookings are confirmed (instant / partner review)
- Note that the schedule may change or be canceled due to severe weather or too few participants
products.hintItineraryRequired: Add an image or text to the itinerary

code.CHILD_PRICE_OVER_ADULT: The child price is higher than the adult price.
code.PRICE_OUTLIER: This price differs by an order of magnitude from the others. Check for an extra zero.
code.CANCEL_RULE_RANGE: A cancellation fee value is out of range.
code.CANCEL_RULE_DUPLICATE: The same cancellation deadline is entered twice.
code.CANCEL_RULE_NOT_INCREASING: The cancellation fee decreases as the departure date approaches.
code.DEADLINE_INVALID: The booking deadline is not valid.
code.SALE_RANGE_EMPTY: The sales schedule has no sellable dates.
code.CANCEL_RULE_RELAXED: The cancellation policy is looser than before.
code.TEXT_FIELD_MISMATCH: The description contradicts the entered values.
code.EXTERNAL_CONTACT: The description appears to direct customers to book or contact outside the platform.
